title: Bhai Bhagtu Gives Temporary Shelter Before the Chattarsal Threat

blocks.text: Even after receiving assurance, the family still faces the practical question of where to live immediately. Bhai Bhagtu offered them shelter, and the episode balances the Guru's promise of future establishment with the ordinary necessity of present refuge.

The page then widens into a darker political horizon. The chronicler introduces one emperor Chattarsal in the South, a ruler described as perpetually drunk and unstable, preparing the conflict that will soon descend upon the fragile settlers.
As a result, the page functions as both reassurance and warning. Shelter has been found, but the wilderness into which the family has been received is about to be disturbed by royal violence.
